import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import resource
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from devtools.reference_validator.model import Atom, Model, point, scalar
from devtools.reference_validator.compare import compare_reference_claims

protocol_path, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
spec = json.loads(protocol_path.read_text())
root = Path.cwd()
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write(path, value):
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False); stream.write('\n')
for relative, digest in spec['frozen_files'].items():
    assert sha(root / relative) == digest, relative
assert len(os.sched_getaffinity(0)) == 1
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
start = time.perf_counter()
import topomt
from devtools.benchlab.ball_study import receive
from devtools.benchlab.capture_volume import encode_quantities
from devtools.benchlab.public_contract import describe_public_contract
from devtools.benchlab.residence_witnesses import inspect_residence_witnesses
reference = Model.from_record(json.loads((root/spec['reference_model']).read_text()))
proof = json.loads((root/spec['reference_certificate']).read_text())
native_start = time.perf_counter()
topo = receive(root/spec['case_directory'], spec['probe_angstroms'])
native_seconds = time.perf_counter()-native_start
mesh = topo.dfnd.mesh.atoms
atoms = tuple(Atom(int(i),point([float(x) for x in xyz]),scalar(float(r))) for i,xyz,r in zip(mesh.index_map,mesh.coords,mesh.radii))
# The domain is reused only after exact center/source equality. Its definition
# is the closed hull of these same centers, not a fresh float hull comparison.
assert [a.source_id for a in atoms] == [a.source_id for a in reference.atoms]
assert [a.center for a in atoms] == [a.center for a in reference.atoms]
native_model = Model(atoms,scalar(float(topo.dfnd.dfn.query.probe_radius)),reference.domain,reference.source_sha256,0,'received_binary64_nm')
write(output/'native_model.json',native_model.to_record())
public = describe_public_contract(topo)
witnesses = inspect_residence_witnesses(topo)
write(output/'native_public.json',encode_quantities({'public_observation':public,'residence_witnesses':witnesses,'attribution':topomt.get_attribution(topo)}))
points = {f"resident_{w['tetrahedron_id']}":point(w['center']) for w in witnesses['witnesses']}
carriers = {c['component_id']:c['tetrahedron_source_support'] for c in public['wet_components']}
compare_start = time.perf_counter()
result = compare_reference_claims(reference,proof,native_model=native_model,points=points,paths={},carrier_tetrahedra=carriers)
write(output/'comparison.json',result)
dependencies = {}
for name in ['molsysmt','pyunitwizard','ackredit']:
    origin = importlib.util.find_spec(name).origin
    folder = Path(origin).resolve().parents[1]
    dependencies[name] = {'origin':origin,'revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=folder,text=True).strip(),
                          'status':subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short'],cwd=folder,text=True).splitlines()}
receipt = {'schema':'topomt.reference-validator.native-spatial-receiving/1','owner':'uibcdf/topomt#181','recorded_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'source_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'protocol_sha256':sha(protocol_path),
    'native_execution':'fresh_source_public_receiving_on_original_frozen_input','numerical_model_match':result['numerical_model_match'],
    'native_model_sha256':native_model.digest,'reference_model_sha256':reference.digest,'native_seconds':native_seconds,
    'comparison_seconds':time.perf_counter()-compare_start,'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,
    'peak_rss_kib_linux':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'dependencies':dependencies,
    'runtime':sys.version,'executable':sys.executable,'cpu_affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
    'address_space_limit_bytes':resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS)[0],
    'scope':'Same exact input/domain/probe; full submitted native carriers proved excluded by complete domain exclusion. Local operators and native promotion policy are not changed.',
    'files':{str(p.relative_to(output)):sha(p) for p in output.rglob('*.json')}}
write(output/'receipt.json',receipt)
print(json.dumps({k:receipt[k] for k in ['numerical_model_match','native_seconds','comparison_seconds','elapsed_seconds','peak_rss_kib_linux']}),flush=True)
